req.title: Reflect query parameters on GET
req.statement: The system shall include client-supplied query parameters under the 'args' key of the GET /get response body.
expected_outcomes: response args field mirrors query string

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /get must reflect client-supplied query parameters under the 'args' key. I design tests covering: (1) a positive EP case with a single k=v pair asserting exact key and value; (2) a positive EP case with multiple parameters; (3) a negative/NEG case with no query parameters asserting args is an empty dict; (4) a BVA boundary case with an empty-value parameter; (5) a DT case verifying that args does NOT bleed into other top-level keys; (6) a BVA case with a single-character key and value (minimal boundary); (7) a NEG case verifying POST /post does not satisfy the GET /get contract. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant, operator, and key-name mutations.

tests.name: test_get_single_query_param_reflected_in_args
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
trace: R-HTTPBIN-002: args key mirrors query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_single_query_param_reflected_in_args():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'args' in body
    assert body['args'] == {'foo': 'bar'}
    assert len(body['args']) == 1

test_get_single_query_param_reflected_in_args()

tests.name: test_get_args_not_leaked_into_other_top_level_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: Response body contains keys: url, args, headers, origin
No query param value appears under 'headers' or 'origin'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-002: args key is isolated; query params must not bleed into other keys
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_args_not_leaked_into_other_top_level_keys():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get?x=99')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert set(body.keys()) == {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'origin'}
    assert body['args'] == {'x': '99'}
    assert 'x' not in body['headers']
    assert body['origin'] != '99'

test_get_args_not_leaked_into_other_top_level_keys()

from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_duplicate_key_returns_list_in_args():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get?k=v1&k=v2')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'args' in body
    assert 'k' in body['args']
    assert body['args']['k'] == ['v1', 'v2']
    assert len(body['args']) == 1

tests.name: test_post_endpoint_does_not_satisfy_get_args_contract
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-002: GET /get only accepts GET; wrong method must be rejected
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_post_endpoint_does_not_satisfy_get_args_contract():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post('/get?foo=bar')
    assert r.status_code == 405
    assert r.status_code != 200
